categoryReasons.schemaAndBindings: The manifest defines one literal load query and the template reads the corresponding data.health payload without unnecessary parameters.
categoryReasons.apiAndRequestDesign: The configured unauthenticated source and GET /v1/health match the verified contract and no unsupported endpoint is introduced.
categoryReasons.runtimeCompatibility: It uses the documented status and data roots, RefreshButton, safe UTC formatting, and supported map expressions.
categoryReasons.goalFulfillment: The summary card and service rows cover overall state, incidents, latency, last check, and the supplied service details.
categoryReasons.visualQuality: A bordered summary card separates the service list, but the three equal KPIs and repeated standard rows feel generic and the main health state lacks strong emphasis.
categoryReasons.responsiveAndTheme: SimpleGrid cols={3} fixes all summary values into three columns, making the timestamp and metrics poorly suited to narrow dashboard tiles.
categoryReasons.loadingEmptyErrorSuccess: Loading, error, missing payload, empty services, and populated data each have a visible branch, but the failure branch discards available status details.
categoryReasons.dailyUsefulness: The refresh control and useful data are present, but fixed KPI columns are likely to compromise repeated use in the explicitly requested narrow tiles.
categoryReasons.complexityDiscipline: A single request and one summary card keep the implementation straightforward, with no dead controls or extra actions.
categoryReasons.accessibility: The refresh control has a visible label and statuses are written in badges, though the small check-time text and cramped fixed grid weaken readability.
categoryReasons.actionSafety: Only the verified read-only query is configured; no mutation or unsupported action is exposed.

strengths: Matches the verified endpoint and authentication contract.
Includes all requested summary fields and service-level status and latency.
Has explicit loading, error, empty, and no-data feedback.
Uses a labeled refresh control and visible text in status badges.
problems: The fixed three-column KPI grid is not responsive to narrow tiles and can compress the timestamp.
The overall state is presented as a badge inside a generic card rather than as the strongest visual signal.
The error branch gives only a generic message despite the available status text or error fields.
highestImpactFixes: Replace the fixed three-column KPI layout with a width-adaptive summary arrangement.
Promote the overall status and preserve error context in the visible failure state.
